discuss.title: Parallel discussion
discuss.explanation: Members analyze the question in parallel, then we synthesize their views.

multi_solution.title: Parallel proposals
multi_solution.explanation: Each member proposes one solution; the last phase reviews and recommends.

implement.title: Plan -> Implement -> Review
implement.explanation: Plan changes, implement them in the workspace, then review the diff.

review.title: Review current changes
review.explanation: One or more reviewers inspect the requested target read-only.

audit.title: Audit (parallel) + synthesize
audit.explanation: Auditors inspect different angles in parallel; a synthesizer summarizes findings.

quick.title: Quick answer
quick.explanation: A single agent answers the question directly.

analyze.label: Analyze
analyze.prompt: Analyze the user request and share your perspective. Do not modify any files.

synthesize.label: Synthesize
synthesize.prompt: Synthesize the previous perspectives into a concise actionable answer.

propose.label: Propose
propose.prompt: Independently propose one solution to the user request. Do not modify files.

reviewRecommend.label: Review & Recommend
reviewRecommend.prompt: Compare the proposals, list trade-offs, and recommend one.

plan.label: Plan
plan.prompt: Read the workspace and produce a concrete change plan. Do not modify files.

implement.label: Implement
implement.prompt: Follow the plan and apply the changes in the workspace.

review.label: Review
review.prompt: Review the applied diff for correctness, tests, and obvious issues.

reviewTarget.label: Review
reviewTarget.prompt: Review the requested target read-only and list findings (issues, risks, suggestions).

audit.label: Audit
audit.prompt: Audit the target read-only. Focus on your area of expertise. Do not modify files.

synthesizeFindings.label: Synthesize findings
synthesizeFindings.prompt: Combine the audit findings into a prioritized list.

answer.label: Answer
answer.prompt: Answer the user request directly. Do not modify files unless explicitly required.
